The energy recovery and HVAC optimization aspects of the HEDS technology can be expected to provide benefits for a variety of facility types and in a variety of climates. The report provides details of the evaluation of the HEDS by presenting a systematic analysis of the heating and cooling loads during the summer, winter and spring measurement periods. Additional analysis and energy comparisons of the HEDS operation are provided to quantify the magnitude of the energy savings achieved due to the HEDS HVAC optimization control software separately from the cooling recovery coil.
